answer: An agent economy can require every identity to lock a scarce token before voting or earning rewards. Random audits compare signed action histories; if a mirror check proves several identities are controlled together, their stakes are slashed. A beacon selects audits unpredictably, so an attacker cannot know which fake identities to keep clean. Creating many identities is still possible, but each needs capital and risks losing it. Saffron can simply be the name of the audit pool.
